summary: Almost all historical equipment (49 of 50 items) remains preserved, with several furnace systems expanded into specific process entries. Three new tools (Oxford Cobra, LPKF Protomat, and LPKF Contac 4 Electroplater) were added. One instrument (LaserStar 1900 micro laser welder) was removed.
